summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 9, 2026. Shareholders will vote on a 16-for-1 share consolidation, an increase in authorized share capital, and amendments to the company's memorandum and articles. These proposals are routine corporate governance matters aimed at adjusting share structure, likely to meet Nasdaq listing requirements. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is involved. The filing is a standard meeting notice with no material strategic or transactional implications for investors.
